text:
Anya: GA in 10 days. Let's make a compact ship checklist we can sign-off in one pass: SLA table, API freeze, docs (quickstart + migration), support rota, monitoring alerts, pricing runway. Who takes what?
Luis: I'll own SLA numbers and the rollback criteria. Proposal: Hosted 99.9% uptime; p99 soft <=330ms / hard <=600ms. Dedicated 99.95%; p99 soft <=260ms / hard <=430ms. Maintenance policy: 48h notice for Dedicated, 4h console notice for Hosted.
Mira: I'll handle monitoring & alerts. Dashboards needed: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens-per-request, KV hit-rate, GPU util. Alerts: p99>600ms, error-rate>1% 5m, token-cost spike>25% 15m.
Kat: Docs: I'll own the dev docs. Need API surface freeze by EOD Thu so snippets don't drift. Will add an "if things go wrong" quick-runbook and a migration table for parameter renames.
Sam: Pricing: propose Dev (metered + free tier), Standard (metered + soft limits), Enterprise (committed). Add optional burst credits. Finance wants cost-per-token from Luis to model intro rates.
Ivy: Support/ops: plan is 72h elevated oncall from GA start (two-person primary + two backups per 24h). Escalation ladder: SRE -> Eng lead -> Product -> Exec. I'll publish rota draft by Tue.
Ryan: Legal: I'll draft the SLA appendix and a short pilot SOW template. Product, flag any private-preview features we should exclude from SLA.
Luis: Running perf sweep Mon/Tue. If p99 goes above soft target, request permission to enable temporary burst capacity and flip to fallback model. Will attach logs to GH issue.
Kat: Docs checklist: quickstart (<5min), API diff, SDK snippets (py/js), migration table, runbook link, "what changed" blurb. I'll open skeleton PR after freeze.
Mira: Add a rollback playbook to dashboards: how to switch model variant, drain region, toggle autoscale. Validate these during perf tests.
Sam: Finance question: Dedicated GA customers - prefer flat committed invoice for predictability; need contract wording for overages.
Ivy: Also add customer comms templates to docs: pre-announce maintenance, GA launch email, incident status template.
Ryan: For pilot customers under NDA, include a pilot addendum that clarifies support level and rollback rights. I'll share a draft Wed.
Anya: Action owners recap: SLA -> Luis, Monitoring -> Mira, Docs -> Kat, Pricing -> Sam, Support rota -> Ivy, Legal -> Ryan. I'll create a GH sign-off checklist and tag owners.
ci-bot: Canary deploy to staging succeeded (sha: b7d3a1c). Smoke tests: passed.
Luis: Perf logs will be attached to the GH issue after runs. If metrics look marginal, I may request a short soft-gate to buy more tuning time.
Kat: Noted. API freeze Thurs EOD. I'll schedule PR reviews Fri morning.
Mira: I'll instrument cost-anomaly alerts and confirm thresholds with Finance.
Sam: Will draft provisional GA pricing tiers and intro discount proposal by Wed. Need Luis's cost numbers to finalize.
Ivy: Publishing rota Tue. Ops will cover first 72h; Eng leads please confirm on-call names.
Ryan: Tagging Legal: will need the final SLA numbers and explicit list of excluded features to complete appendix.
Anya: Final sync next Thu 10am PT to review perf, docs PRs, and pricing. If anyone can't meet their deadlines, flag here immediately. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Scheduled production canary for Thu 03:00 UTC (commit: b7d3a1c).
Kat: I'll post the docs skeleton later today and ping reviewers.
Luis: Thanks — will post perf summary once completed.
Anya: Closing loop: GH checklist up in 5m. Use this thread for last-minute blockers.
